aws_service: Amazon Bedrock Guardrails / Amazon Bedrock AgentCore / AWS Lambda / AWS WAF / Amazon CloudWatch / Amazon API Gateway
guidance: Agents generate tool parameters from model output, which means malformed or adversarial inputs can reach tools through ordinary reasoning, not just through unauthorized callers. Schema-driven validation on inputs and sanitization on outputs keep tools operating inside their intended parameter space and help prevent error messages from disclosing internal system details.
how_to_check: • You validate every parameter passed to tools against a defined schema before execution, and sanitize tool outputs before returning them to the agent. • Injection through tool parameters is blocked, oversized inputs are prevented from exhausting resources, and error messages are sanitized to avoid leaking sensitive system information. • Tool invocations operate predictably within defined boundaries, and validation failures are logged for security analysis. For more information, see the AGENTSEC02-BP02 documentation.
